description: This file defines utilities for launching and managing child processes, including handling signals, cleanup, and process termination in the context of the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: gracefullyCloseAll
methods.description: Closes all processes gracefully by invoking registered close functions.

methods.name: gracefullyProcessExitDoNotHang
methods.description: Exits the process after attempting to gracefully close all processes, with a timeout to prevent hanging.

methods.name: launchProcess
methods.description: Launches a child process with specified options, manages its lifecycle, and handles signals and cleanup.

methods.name: envArrayToObject
methods.description: Converts an array of environment variable objects to a key-value object.
